target.title: Avengers: Doomsday
target.why: December 18, 2026. Doctor Doom (Robert Downey Jr.) versus the Avengers, the New Avengers, the Fantastic Four and the X-Men.
target.overview: Beloved heroes from three distinct universes are set on a deadly collision course and face an existential threat unlike anything they've ever encountered.

lanes.label: Marvel before the MCU
lanes.note: The 1998–2008 films; none of it connects

lanes.label: X-Men (Fox era)
lanes.note: The original Fox X-Men cast is in Doomsday

lanes.label: Avengers films
lanes.note: The team's history, and who Tony Stark was

lanes.label: Captain America → New Avengers
lanes.note: The team that will actually be on screen

lanes.label: Wakanda & Namor
lanes.note: Shuri and Namor are both in the cast

target.label: The movie
target.note: What all of this leads to

essential.label: Must watch
essential.note: Direct setup: characters, stakes or rules the film builds on

recommended.label: Worth watching
recommended.note: Introduces someone in the cast or a thread the film picks up

background.label: Only if curious
background.note: Loosely connected; skip without losing the plot

catalog.label: Everything else
catalog.note: The wider Marvel catalogue, on the map for completeness

nodes.title: Blade
nodes.why: Mahershala Ali's Blade is still coming to the MCU; this is the original.
nodes.overview: The Daywalker known as "Blade" - a half-vampire, half-mortal man - becomes the protector of humanity against an underground army of vampires.

nodes.title: X-Men
nodes.why: Where Patrick Stewart's Professor X, Ian McKellen's Magneto, James Marsden's Cyclops and Rebecca Romijn's Mystique begin — all four are in Doomsday's cast.
nodes.overview: Two mutants, Rogue and Wolverine, come to a private academy for their kind whose resident superhero team, the X-Men, must oppose a terrorist organization with similar powers.

nodes.title: Blade II
nodes.why: A Marvel film from before the shared universe; nothing here carries into Doomsday.
nodes.overview: Blade forms an uneasy alliance with the vampire council in order to combat the Reapers, who are feeding on vampires.

nodes.title: Spider-Man
nodes.why: Tobey Maguire's Spider-Man, who returns in No Way Home.
nodes.overview: After being bitten by a genetically altered spider at Oscorp, nerdy but endearing high school student Peter Parker is endowed with amazing powers to become the superhero known as Spider-Man.

nodes.title: Daredevil
nodes.why: A Marvel film from before the shared universe; nothing here carries into Doomsday.
nodes.overview: By day, blind attorney Matt Murdock toils for justice in Hell's Kitchen. By night, he's Daredevil, The Man Without Fear - a powerful, masked vigilante stalking the dark streets with an uncanny "radar sense" that allows him to "see" with superhuman capabilities. But when the love of his life, fiery Elektra Natchios, is targeted by New York City's ruthless Kingpin of crime and his deadly assassin Bu

nodes.title: X2: X-Men United
nodes.why: Introduces Alan Cumming's Nightcrawler, who is also returning. The best of the original trilogy.
nodes.overview: Professor Charles Xavier and his team of genetically gifted superheroes face a rising tide of anti-mutant sentiment led by Col. William Stryker. Storm, Wolverine and Jean Grey must join Magneto and Mystique to unhinge Stryker's scheme to exterminate all mutants.

nodes.title: Hulk
nodes.why: A Marvel film from before the shared universe; nothing here carries into Doomsday.
nodes.overview: Bruce Banner, a genetics researcher with a tragic past, suffers massive radiation exposure in his laboratory that causes him to transform into a raging green monster when he gets angry.

nodes.title: The Punisher
nodes.why: A Marvel film from before the shared universe; nothing here carries into Doomsday.
nodes.overview: When undercover FBI agent Frank Castle's wife and son are slaughtered, he becomes 'the Punisher' -- a ruthless vigilante willing to go to any length to avenge his family.

nodes.title: Spider-Man 2
nodes.why: Often called the best Spider-Man film; Doc Ock returns in No Way Home.
nodes.overview: Peter Parker is going through a major identity crisis. Burned out from being Spider-Man, he decides to shelve his superhero alter ego, which leaves the city suffering in the wake of carnage left by the evil Doc Ock. In the meantime, Parker still can't act on his feelings for Mary Jane Watson, a girl he's loved since childhood. A certain anger begins to brew in his best friend Harry Osborn as well.

nodes.title: Blade: Trinity
nodes.why: A Marvel film from before the shared universe; nothing here carries into Doomsday.
nodes.overview: For years, Blade has fought against the vampires in the cover of the night. But now, after falling into the crosshairs of the FBI, he is forced out into the daylight, where he is driven to join forces with a clan of human vampire hunters he never knew existed—The Nightstalkers. Together with Abigail and Hannibal, two deftly trained Nightstalkers, Blade follows a trail of blood to the ancient creat

nodes.title: Elektra
nodes.why: A Marvel film from before the shared universe; nothing here carries into Doomsday.
nodes.overview: Elektra the warrior survives a near-death experience, becomes an assassin-for-hire, and tries to protect her two latest targets, a single father and his young daughter, from a group of supernatural assassins.

nodes.title: Fantastic Four
nodes.why: The first Fantastic Four film, with Julian McMahon's Doom.
nodes.overview: During a space voyage, four scientists are altered by cosmic rays: Reed Richards gains the ability to stretch his body; Sue Storm can become invisible; Johnny Storm controls fire; and Ben Grimm is turned into a super-strong … thing. Together, these "Fantastic Four" must now thwart the evil plans of Dr. Doom and save the world from certain destruction.

nodes.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
nodes.why: Kelsey Grammer's Beast debuts here; otherwise skippable.
nodes.overview: When a cure is found to treat mutations, lines are drawn amongst the X-Men led by Professor Charles Xavier, and Magneto's Brotherhood of Mutants.

nodes.title: Ghost Rider
nodes.why: A Marvel film from before the shared universe; nothing here carries into Doomsday.
nodes.overview: In order to save his dying father, young stunt cyclist Johnny Blaze sells his soul to Mephistopheles and sadly parts from the pure-hearted Roxanne Simpson, the love of his life. Years later, Johnny's path crosses again with Roxanne, now a go-getting reporter, and also with Mephistopheles, who offers to release Johnny's soul if Johnny becomes the fabled, fiery 'Ghost Rider'.

nodes.title: Spider-Man 3
nodes.why: Part of the Spider-Man side of Marvel; not needed for Doomsday.
nodes.overview: The seemingly invincible Spider-Man goes up against an all-new crop of villains—including the shape-shifting Sandman. While Spider-Man’s superpowers are altered by an alien organism, his alter ego, Peter Parker, deals with nemesis Eddie Brock and also gets caught up in a love triangle.

nodes.title: Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer
nodes.why: A Marvel film from before the shared universe; nothing here carries into Doomsday.
nodes.overview: The Fantastic Four return to the big screen as a new and all powerful enemy threatens the Earth. The seemingly unstoppable 'Silver Surfer', but all is not what it seems and there are old and new enemies that pose a greater threat than the intrepid superheroes realize.
nodes.tmdb_title: Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer

nodes.title: Iron Man
nodes.why: Where Tony Stark starts. Robert Downey Jr. plays Doctor Doom in Doomsday, so his Iron Man arc is the emotional backdrop.
nodes.overview: After being held captive in an Afghan cave, billionaire engineer Tony Stark creates a unique weaponized suit of armor to fight evil.

nodes.title: The Incredible Hulk
nodes.why: Harrison Ford's Ross replaces William Hurt's; Red Hulk pays off in Brave New World.
nodes.overview: Scientist Bruce Banner scours the planet for an antidote to the unbridled force of rage within him: the Hulk. But when the military masterminds who dream of exploiting his powers force him back to civilization, he finds himself coming face to face with a new, deadly foe.

nodes.title: Punisher: War Zone
nodes.why: A Marvel film from before the shared universe; nothing here carries into Doomsday.
nodes.overview: Waging his one-man war on the world of organized crime, ruthless vigilante-hero Frank Castle sets his sights on overeager mob boss Billy Russoti. After Russoti is left horribly disfigured by Castle, he sets out for vengeance under his new alias: Jigsaw. With the "Punisher Task Force" hot on his trail and the FBI unable to take Jigsaw in, Frank must stand up to the formidable army that Jigsaw has r

nodes.title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
nodes.why: A Fox-era X-Men film; the cast overlap is the only link.
nodes.overview: After seeking to live a normal life after 200 years, Logan sets out to avenge a death by undergoing the mutant Weapon X program and becoming Wolverine.

nodes.title: Iron Man 2
nodes.why: An earlier Avengers-era film; background for the team's history.
nodes.overview: With the world now aware of his dual life as the armored superhero Iron Man, billionaire inventor Tony Stark faces pressure from the government, the press and the public to share his technology with the military. Unwilling to let go of his invention, Stark, with Pepper Potts and James 'Rhodey' Rhodes at his side, must forge new alliances – and confront powerful enemies.

nodes.title: Thor
nodes.why: Chris Hemsworth's first outing; Loki's too.
nodes.overview: Against his father Odin's will, The Mighty Thor - a powerful but arrogant warrior god - recklessly reignites an ancient war. Thor is cast down to Earth and forced to live among humans as punishment. Once here, Thor learns what it takes to be a true hero when the most dangerous villain of his world sends the darkest forces of Asgard to invade Earth.

nodes.title: X-Men: First Class
nodes.why: A Fox-era X-Men film; the cast overlap is the only link.
nodes.overview: Before Charles Xavier and Erik Lensherr took the names Professor X and Magneto, they were two young men discovering their powers for the first time. Before they were arch-enemies, they were closest of friends, working together with other mutants (some familiar, some new), to stop the greatest threat the world has ever known.

nodes.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
nodes.why: Steve and Bucky's friendship starts here.
nodes.overview: During World War II, Steve Rogers is a sickly man from Brooklyn who's transformed into super-soldier Captain America to aid in the war effort. Rogers must stop the Red Skull – Adolf Hitler's ruthless head of weaponry, and the leader of an organization that intends to use a mysterious device of untold powers for world domination.

nodes.title: Ghost Rider: Spirit of Vengeance
nodes.why: A Marvel film from before the shared universe; nothing here carries into Doomsday.
nodes.overview: When the devil resurfaces with aims to take over the world in human form, Johnny Blaze reluctantly comes out of hiding to transform into the flame-spewing supernatural hero Ghost Rider -- and rescue a 10-year-old boy from an unsavory end.

nodes.title: The Avengers
nodes.why: The team's first assembly — the template Doomsday's three teams echo.
nodes.overview: When an unexpected enemy emerges and threatens global safety and security, Nick Fury, director of the international peacekeeping agency known as S.H.I.E.L.D., finds himself in need of a team to pull the world back from the brink of disaster. Spanning the globe, a daring recruitment effort begins!

nodes.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
nodes.why: Andrew Garfield's Spider-Man, who returns in No Way Home.
nodes.overview: A teenage Peter Parker grapples with both high school and amazing super-human crises as his alter-ego Spider-Man.

nodes.title: Iron Man 3
nodes.why: An earlier Avengers-era film; background for the team's history.
nodes.overview: When Tony Stark's world is torn apart by a formidable terrorist called the Mandarin, he starts an odyssey of rebuilding and retribution.

nodes.title: The Wolverine
nodes.why: A Fox-era X-Men film; the cast overlap is the only link.
nodes.overview: Wolverine faces his ultimate nemesis - and tests of his physical, emotional, and mortal limits - in a life-changing voyage to modern-day Japan.

nodes.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
nodes.why: Seven seasons alongside the films; largely its own thing.
nodes.overview: Agent Phil Coulson of S.H.I.E.L.D. (Strategic Homeland Intervention, Enforcement and Logistics Division) puts together a team of agents to investigate the new, the strange and the unknown around the globe, protecting the ordinary from the extraordinary.

nodes.title: Thor: The Dark World
nodes.why: An earlier Avengers-era film; background for the team's history.
nodes.overview: Thor fights to restore order across the cosmos… but an ancient race led by the vengeful Malekith returns to plunge the universe back into darkness. Faced with an enemy that even Odin and Asgard cannot withstand, Thor must embark on his most perilous and personal journey yet, one that will reunite him with Jane Foster and force him to sacrifice everything to save us all.

nodes.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
nodes.why: Bucky's return and Sam's first mission with Steve; the roots of the Sam and Bucky partnership.
nodes.overview: After the cataclysmic events in New York with The Avengers, Steve Rogers, aka Captain America is living quietly in Washington, D.C. and trying to adjust to the modern world. But when a S.H.I.E.L.D. colleague comes under attack, Steve becomes embroiled in a web of intrigue that threatens to put the world at risk. Joining forces with the Black Widow, Captain America struggles to expose the ever-wide

nodes.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
nodes.why: Electro returns in No Way Home.
nodes.overview: For Peter Parker, life is busy. Between taking out the bad guys as Spider-Man and spending time with the person he loves, Gwen Stacy, high school graduation cannot come quickly enough. Peter has not forgotten about the promise he made to Gwen’s father to protect her by staying away, but that is a promise he cannot keep. Things will change for Peter when a new villain, Electro, emerges, an old frie

nodes.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
nodes.why: Reunites the whole original cast and rewrites their timeline — the version of these characters most likely to show up.
nodes.overview: The ultimate X-Men ensemble fights a war for the survival of the species across two time periods as they join forces with their younger selves in an epic battle that must change the past – to save our future.

nodes.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
nodes.why: The cosmic side of the MCU; not where Doomsday's story lives.
nodes.overview: Light years from Earth, 26 years after being abducted, Peter Quill finds himself the prime target of a manhunt after discovering an orb wanted by Ronan the Accuser.

nodes.title: Agent Carter
nodes.why: A Marvel Television series from the network years; loosely connected at best.
nodes.overview: It's 1946, and peace has dealt Peggy Carter a serious blow as she finds herself marginalized when the men return home from fighting abroad. Working for the covert SSR (Strategic Scientific Reserve), Peggy must balance doing administrative work and going on secret missions for Howard Stark all while trying to navigate life as a single woman in America, in the wake of losing the love of her life - S

nodes.title: Daredevil
nodes.why: Charlie Cox and Vincent D'Onofrio's series, continued by Born Again.
nodes.overview: Lawyer-by-day Matt Murdock uses his heightened senses from being blinded as a young boy to fight crime at night on the streets of Hell’s Kitchen as Daredevil.

nodes.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
nodes.why: Vision is born; see VisionQuest.
nodes.overview: When Tony Stark tries to jumpstart a dormant peacekeeping program, things go awry and Earth’s Mightiest Heroes are put to the ultimate test as the fate of the planet hangs in the balance. As the villainous Ultron emerges, it is up to The Avengers to stop him from enacting his terrible plans, and soon uneasy alliances and unexpected action pave the way for an epic and unique global adventure.

nodes.title: Ant-Man
nodes.why: Paul Rudd's Scott Lang; the Quantum Realm starts here.
nodes.overview: Armed with the astonishing ability to shrink in scale but increase in strength, master thief Scott Lang must embrace his inner-hero and help his mentor, Doctor Hank Pym, protect the secret behind his spectacular Ant-Man suit from a new generation of towering threats. Against seemingly insurmountable obstacles, Pym and Lang must plan and pull off a heist that will save the world.

nodes.title: Fantastic Four
nodes.why: The 2015 reboot; unrelated to First Steps.
nodes.overview: Four young outsiders teleport to a dangerous universe, which alters their physical form in shocking ways. Their lives irrevocably upended, the team must learn to harness their daunting new abilities and work together to save Earth from a former friend turned enemy.

nodes.title: Jessica Jones
nodes.why: Street-level Marvel; good television, separate from the cosmic plot.
nodes.overview: After a tragic ending to her short-lived super hero stint, Jessica Jones is rebuilding her personal life and career as a detective who gets pulled into cases involving people with extraordinary abilities in New York City.

nodes.title: Deadpool
nodes.why: Ryan Reynolds' Deadpool starts here; it matters for Deadpool & Wolverine.
nodes.overview: The origin story of former Special Forces operative turned mercenary Wade Wilson, who, after being subjected to a rogue experiment that leaves him with accelerated healing powers, adopts the alter ego Deadpool. Armed with his new abilities and a dark, twisted sense of humor, Deadpool hunts down the man who nearly destroyed his life.

nodes.title: Captain America: Civil War
nodes.why: Where Sam, Bucky and the fractured team dynamic come from.
nodes.overview: Following the events of Age of Ultron, the collective governments of the world pass an act designed to regulate all superhuman activity. This polarizes opinion amongst the Avengers, causing two factions to side with Iron Man or Captain America, which causes an epic battle between former allies.

nodes.title: X-Men: Apocalypse
nodes.why: Younger cast; only loosely relevant.
nodes.overview: After the re-emergence of the world's first mutant, world-destroyer Apocalypse, the X-Men must unite to defeat his extinction level plan.

nodes.title: Luke Cage
nodes.why: Street-level Marvel; good television, separate from the cosmic plot.
nodes.overview: Given superstrength and durability by a sabotaged experiment, a wrongly accused man escapes prison to become a superhero for hire.

nodes.title: Doctor Strange
nodes.why: Strange's origin; the first look at other dimensions.
nodes.overview: After his career is destroyed, a brilliant but arrogant surgeon gets a new lease on life when a sorcerer takes him under her wing and trains him to defend the world against evil.

nodes.title: Logan
nodes.why: Where Hugh Jackman's Wolverine died — which Deadpool & Wolverine is about.
nodes.overview: In the near future, a weary Logan cares for an ailing Professor X in a hideout on the Mexican border. But Logan's attempts to hide from the world and his legacy are upended when a young mutant arrives, pursued by dark forces.

nodes.title: Iron Fist
nodes.why: Street-level Marvel; good television, separate from the cosmic plot.
nodes.overview: Danny Rand resurfaces 15 years after being presumed dead. Now, with the power of the Iron Fist, he seeks to reclaim his past and fulfill his destiny.

nodes.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
nodes.why: The cosmic side of the MCU; not where Doomsday's story lives.
nodes.overview: The Guardians must fight to keep their newfound family together as they unravel the mysteries of Peter Quill's true parentage.

nodes.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
nodes.why: Tom Holland's first solo film.
nodes.overview: Following the events of Captain America: Civil War, Peter Parker, with the help of his mentor Tony Stark, tries to balance his life as an ordinary high school student in Queens, New York City, with fighting crime as his superhero alter ego Spider-Man as a new threat, the Vulture, emerges.

nodes.title: The Defenders
nodes.why: Street-level Marvel; good television, separate from the cosmic plot.
nodes.overview: Daredevil, Jessica Jones, Luke Cage and Iron Fist join forces to take on common enemies as a sinister conspiracy threatens New York City.

nodes.title: Marvel's Inhumans
nodes.why: A Marvel Television series from the network years; loosely connected at best.
nodes.overview: After the Royal Family of Inhumans is splintered by a military coup, they barely escape to Hawaii where their surprising interactions with the lush world and humanity around them may prove to not only save them, but Earth itself.

nodes.title: Thor: Ragnarok
nodes.why: Thor loses Asgard and his hammer; the version of Thor that walks into Infinity War, Endgame and Doomsday.
nodes.overview: Thor is imprisoned on the other side of the universe and finds himself in a race against time to get back to Asgard to stop Ragnarok, the destruction of his home-world and the end of Asgardian civilization, at the hands of a powerful new threat, the ruthless Hela.

nodes.title: The Punisher
nodes.why: Jon Bernthal's Punisher, back in Born Again.
nodes.overview: A former Marine out to punish the criminals responsible for his family's murder finds himself ensnared in a military conspiracy.

nodes.title: Marvel's Runaways
nodes.why: A Marvel Television series from the network years; loosely connected at best.
nodes.overview: Every teenager thinks their parents are evil. What if you found out they actually were? Six diverse teenagers who can barely stand each other must unite against a common foe – their parents.

nodes.title: Black Panther
nodes.why: Wakanda, Shuri and Okoye; the setup for Wakanda Forever.
nodes.overview: King T'Challa returns home to the reclusive, technologically advanced African nation of Wakanda to serve as his country's new leader. However, T'Challa soon finds that he is challenged for the throne by factions within his own country as well as without. Using powers reserved to Wakandan kings, T'Challa assumes the Black Panther mantle to join with ex-girlfriend Nakia, the queen-mother, his prince

nodes.title: Avengers: Infinity War
nodes.why: The first half of the last big team-up, for the stakes and the losses that still shape the team.
nodes.overview: As the Avengers and their allies have continued to protect the world from threats too large for any one hero to handle, a new danger has emerged from the cosmic shadows: Thanos. A despot of intergalactic infamy, his goal is to collect all six Infinity Stones, artifacts of unimaginable power, and use them to inflict his twisted will on all of reality. Everything the Avengers have fought for has led

nodes.title: Deadpool 2
nodes.why: A Fox-era X-Men film; the cast overlap is the only link.
nodes.overview: Wisecracking mercenary Deadpool battles the evil and powerful Cable and other bad guys to save a boy's life.

nodes.title: Marvel's Cloak & Dagger
nodes.why: A Marvel Television series from the network years; loosely connected at best.
nodes.overview: Two teenagers from very different backgrounds awaken to newly acquired superpowers which mysteriously link them to one another.

nodes.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
nodes.why: A multiverse-adjacent story; light background.
nodes.overview: Just when his time under house arrest is about to end, Scott Lang once again puts his freedom at risk to help Hope van Dyne and Dr. Hank Pym dive into the quantum realm and try to accomplish, against time and any chance of success, a very dangerous rescue mission.

nodes.title: Venom
nodes.why: Sony's Venom; its sequel's tag briefly visits the MCU.
nodes.overview: Investigative journalist Eddie Brock attempts a comeback following a scandal, but accidentally becomes the host of Venom, a violent, super powerful alien symbiote. Soon, he must rely on his newfound powers to protect the world from a shadowy organization looking for a symbiote of their own.

nodes.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
nodes.why: Animated multiverse Spider-Men; not connected, but the idea.
nodes.overview: Struggling to find his place in the world while juggling school and family, Brooklyn teenager Miles Morales is unexpectedly bitten by a radioactive spider and develops unfathomable powers just like the one and only Spider-Man. While wrestling with the implications of his new abilities, Miles discovers a super collider created by the madman Wilson "Kingpin" Fisk, causing others from across the Spid

nodes.title: Captain Marvel
nodes.why: The cosmic side of the MCU; not where Doomsday's story lives.
nodes.overview: The story follows Carol Danvers as she becomes one of the universe’s most powerful heroes when Earth is caught in the middle of a galactic war between two alien races. Set in the 1990s, Captain Marvel is an all-new adventure from a previously unseen period in the history of the Marvel Cinematic Universe.

nodes.title: Avengers: Endgame
nodes.why: Where the Avengers ended, who died and who left. Robert Downey Jr. returns in Doomsday — as Doctor Doom.
nodes.overview: After the devastating events of Avengers: Infinity War, the universe is in ruins due to the efforts of the Mad Titan, Thanos. With the help of remaining allies, the Avengers must assemble once more in order to undo Thanos' actions and restore order to the universe once and for all, no matter what consequences may be in store.

nodes.title: Dark Phoenix
nodes.why: The last Fox X-Men film before the universe folded into Marvel's multiverse.
nodes.overview: The X-Men face their most formidable and powerful foe when one of their own, Jean Grey, starts to spiral out of control. During a rescue mission in outer space, Jean is nearly killed when she's hit by a mysterious cosmic force. Once she returns home, this force not only makes her infinitely more powerful, but far more unstable. The X-Men must now band together to save her soul and battle aliens th

nodes.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
nodes.why: Peter's identity is exposed, which leads straight into No Way Home.
nodes.overview: Peter Parker and his friends go on a summer trip to Europe. However, they will hardly be able to rest - Peter will have to agree to help Nick Fury uncover the mystery of creatures that cause natural disasters and destruction throughout the continent.

nodes.title: The New Mutants
nodes.why: A Fox-era X-Men film; the cast overlap is the only link.
nodes.overview: Five young mutants, just discovering their abilities while held in a secret facility against their will, fight to escape their past sins and save themselves.

nodes.title: Helstrom
nodes.why: A Marvel Television series from the network years; loosely connected at best.
nodes.overview: Daimon and Ana Helstrom are the son and daughter of a mysterious and powerful serial killer. The siblings have a complicated dynamic as they track down the terrorizing worst of humanity — each with their attitude and skills.

nodes.title: WandaVision
nodes.why: Sets up Wanda's turn and the Darkhold, which Multiverse of Madness pays off.
nodes.overview: Wanda Maximoff and Vision—two super-powered beings living idealized suburban lives—begin to suspect that everything is not as it seems.

nodes.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
nodes.why: Sam Wilson takes the shield; John Walker is introduced; Bucky's redemption.
nodes.overview: Following the events of “Avengers: Endgame”, the Falcon, Sam Wilson and the Winter Soldier, Bucky Barnes team up in a global adventure that tests their abilities, and their patience.
nodes.tmdb_title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier

nodes.title: Loki — Season 1
nodes.why: The Time Variance Authority, branching timelines and 'He Who Remains'. Everything multiversal starts here. Tom Hiddleston is in Doomsday.
nodes.overview: After stealing the Tesseract during the events of “Avengers: Endgame,” an alternate version of Loki is brought to the mysterious Time Variance Authority, a bureaucratic organization that exists outside of time and space and monitors the timeline. They give Loki a choice: face being erased from existence due to being a “time variant” or help fix the timeline and stop a greater threat.

nodes.title: Black Widow
nodes.why: Introduces Yelena, Red Guardian and Taskmaster — three of the New Avengers.
nodes.overview: Natasha Romanoff, also known as Black Widow, confronts the darker parts of her ledger when a dangerous conspiracy with ties to her past arises. Pursued by a force that will stop at nothing to bring her down, Natasha must deal with her history as a spy and the broken relationships left in her wake long before she became an Avenger.

nodes.title: What If…?
nodes.why: Animated multiverse stories; fun, not required.
nodes.overview: Taking inspiration from the comic books of the same name, each episode of this animated anthology series questions, revisits and twists classic Marvel Cinematic moments.

nodes.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
nodes.why: Simu Liu's Shang-Chi is in the cast; the Ten Rings mid-credits scene is the hook.
nodes.overview: Shang-Chi must confront the past he thought he left behind when he is drawn into the web of the mysterious Ten Rings organization.
nodes.tmdb_title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings

nodes.title: Venom: Let There Be Carnage
nodes.why: Its post-credits scene drops Venom into the MCU for a moment.
nodes.overview: After finding a host body in investigative reporter Eddie Brock, the alien symbiote must face a new enemy, Carnage, the alter ego of serial killer Cletus Kasady.

nodes.title: Eternals
nodes.why: The dead Celestial Tiamut is where the adamantium in Brave New World comes from.
nodes.overview: The Eternals are a team of ancient aliens who have been living on Earth in secret for thousands of years. When an unexpected tragedy forces them out of the shadows, they are forced to reunite against mankind’s most ancient enemy, the Deviants.

nodes.title: Hawkeye
nodes.why: Yelena hunts Clint; adds depth to her, not required.
nodes.overview: Former Avenger Clint Barton has a seemingly simple mission: get back to his family for Christmas. Possible? Maybe with the help of Kate Bishop, a 22-year-old archer with dreams of becoming a superhero. The two are forced to work together when a presence from Barton’s past threatens to derail far more than the festive spirit.

nodes.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
nodes.why: The first time the multiverse spills into the MCU on screen — variants of the same character meeting.
nodes.overview: Peter Parker is unmasked and no longer able to separate his normal life from the high-stakes of being a super-hero. When he asks for help from Doctor Strange the stakes become even more dangerous, forcing him to discover what it truly means to be Spider-Man.

nodes.title: Moon Knight
nodes.why: Street-level Marvel; good television, separate from the cosmic plot.
nodes.overview: When Steven Grant, a mild-mannered gift-shop employee, becomes plagued with blackouts and memories of another life, he discovers he has dissociative identity disorder and shares a body with mercenary Marc Spector. As Steven/Marc’s enemies converge upon them, they must navigate their complex identities while thrust into a deadly mystery among the powerful gods of Egypt.

nodes.title: Morbius
nodes.why: Part of the Spider-Man side of Marvel; not needed for Doomsday.
nodes.overview: Dangerously ill with a rare blood disorder, and determined to save others suffering his same fate, Dr. Michael Morbius attempts a desperate gamble. What at first appears to be a radical success soon reveals itself to be a remedy potentially worse than the disease.

nodes.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
nodes.why: Explains incursions (universes colliding) and shows the Illuminati with a Reed Richards and a Professor X — the exact ideas Doomsday is built on.
nodes.overview: Doctor Strange, with the help of mystical allies both old and new, traverses the mind-bending and dangerous alternate realities of the Multiverse to confront a mysterious new adversary.
nodes.tmdb_title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness

nodes.title: Ms. Marvel
nodes.why: Leads into The Marvels; its last scene hints at mutants in the MCU.
nodes.overview: A great student, avid gamer, and voracious fan-fic scribe, Kamala Khan has a special affinity for superheroes, particularly Captain Marvel. However, she struggles to fit in at home and at school — that is, until she gets superpowers like the heroes she’s always looked up to. Life is easier with superpowers, right?

nodes.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
nodes.why: Thor's current status quo (and his adopted daughter). Chris Hemsworth is in Doomsday.
nodes.overview: After his retirement is interrupted by Gorr the God Butcher, a galactic killer who seeks the extinction of the gods, Thor Odinson enlists the help of King Valkyrie, Korg, and ex-girlfriend Jane Foster, who now wields Mjolnir as the Mighty Thor. Together they embark upon a harrowing cosmic adventure to uncover the mystery of the God Butcher’s vengeance and stop him before it’s too late.

nodes.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
nodes.why: Daredevil guest-stars; otherwise its own thing.
nodes.overview: Jennifer Walters navigates the complicated life of a single, 30-something attorney who also happens to be a green 6-foot-7-inch superpowered hulk.

nodes.title: Werewolf by Night
nodes.why: Street-level Marvel; good television, separate from the cosmic plot.
nodes.overview: On a dark and somber night, a secret cabal of monster hunters emerge from the shadows and gather at the foreboding Bloodstone Temple following the death of their leader. In a strange and macabre memorial to the leader’s life, the attendees are thrust into a mysterious and deadly competition for a powerful relic—a hunt that will ultimately bring them face to face with a dangerous monster.

nodes.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
nodes.why: Shuri becomes Black Panther and Namor is introduced; both are in the Doomsday cast.
nodes.overview: Queen Ramonda, Shuri, M’Baku, Okoye and the Dora Milaje fight to protect their nation from intervening world powers in the wake of King T’Challa’s death.  As the Wakandans strive to embrace their next chapter, the heroes must band together with the help of War Dog Nakia and Everett Ross and forge a new path for the kingdom of Wakanda.

nodes.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
nodes.why: The cosmic side of the MCU; not where Doomsday's story lives.
nodes.overview: On a mission to make Christmas unforgettable for Quill, the Guardians head to Earth in search of the perfect present.
nodes.tmdb_title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special

nodes.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
nodes.why: Kang and the Council of Kangs — a thread Marvel set aside when it moved to Doom. Paul Rudd is in Doomsday regardless.
nodes.overview: Super-Hero partners Scott Lang and Hope van Dyne, along with with Hope's parents Janet van Dyne and Hank Pym, and Scott's daughter Cassie Lang, find themselves exploring the Quantum Realm, interacting with strange new creatures and embarking on an adventure that will push them beyond the limits of what they thought possible.

nodes.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
nodes.why: The Guardians' farewell.
nodes.overview: Peter Quill, still reeling from the loss of Gamora, must rally his team around him to defend the universe along with protecting one of their own. A mission that, if not completed successfully, could quite possibly lead to the end of the Guardians as we know them.

nodes.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
nodes.why: Part of the Spider-Man side of Marvel; not needed for Doomsday.
nodes.overview: After reuniting with Gwen Stacy, Brooklyn’s full-time, friendly neighborhood Spider-Man is catapulted across the Multiverse, where he encounters the Spider Society, a team of Spider-People charged with protecting the Multiverse's very existence. But when the heroes clash on how to handle a new threat, Miles finds himself pitted against the other Spiders and must set out on his own to save those he

nodes.title: Secret Invasion
nodes.why: The cosmic side of the MCU; not where Doomsday's story lives.
nodes.overview: Nick Fury and Talos discover a faction of shapeshifting Skrulls who have been infiltrating Earth for years.

nodes.title: Loki — Season 2
nodes.why: Loki ends up holding the entire multiverse together. Whatever Doom does to it goes through him.
nodes.overview: After stealing the Tesseract during the events of “Avengers: Endgame,” an alternate version of Loki is brought to the mysterious Time Variance Authority, a bureaucratic organization that exists outside of time and space and monitors the timeline. They give Loki a choice: face being erased from existence due to being a “time variant” or help fix the timeline and stop a greater threat.

nodes.title: The Marvels
nodes.why: Its final scene puts Monica Rambeau in the X-Men universe face to face with Kelsey Grammer's Beast — the first handshake between the two worlds.
nodes.overview: When her duties send her to an anomalous wormhole linked to a Kree revolutionary, Carol's powers become entangled with that of Jersey City super-fan Kamala Khan, aka Ms. Marvel, and Carol's estranged niece, now S.A.B.E.R. astronaut Captain Monica Rambeau. Together, this unlikely trio must team up and learn to work in concert to save the universe.

nodes.title: Echo
nodes.why: Kingpin's return, bridging to Born Again.
nodes.overview: Pursued by Wilson Fisk's criminal empire, Maya's journey brings her home and she must confront her own family and legacy.

nodes.title: Madame Web
nodes.why: Part of the Spider-Man side of Marvel; not needed for Doomsday.
nodes.overview: Forced to confront revelations about her past, paramedic Cassandra Webb forges a relationship with three young women destined for powerful futures...if they can all survive a deadly present.

nodes.title: X-Men '97
nodes.why: The animated continuation; the warmest way back into the X-Men before they hit the MCU.
nodes.overview: The X-Men, a band of mutants who use their uncanny gifts to protect a world that hates and fears them, are challenged like never before, forced to face a dangerous and unexpected new future.

nodes.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
nodes.why: The bridge: the Fox universe meets the TVA, dying timelines, the Void. This is how the X-Men can reach the MCU.
nodes.overview: A listless Wade Wilson toils away in civilian life with his days as the morally flexible mercenary, Deadpool, behind him. But when his homeworld faces an existential threat, Wade must reluctantly suit-up again with an even more reluctant Wolverine.

nodes.title: Agatha All Along
nodes.why: Follows WandaVision's witches; a side road.
nodes.overview: Agatha Harkness gathers a coven of witches and sets off down, down, down The Witches' Road.

nodes.title: Venom: The Last Dance
nodes.why: Part of the Spider-Man side of Marvel; not needed for Doomsday.
nodes.overview: Eddie and Venom are on the run. Hunted by both of their worlds and with the net closing in, the duo are forced into a devastating decision that will bring the curtains down on Venom and Eddie's last dance.

nodes.title: Kraven the Hunter
nodes.why: Part of the Spider-Man side of Marvel; not needed for Doomsday.
nodes.overview: Kraven Kravinoff's complex relationship with his ruthless gangster father, Nikolai, starts him down a path of vengeance with brutal consequences, motivating him to become not only the greatest hunter in the world, but also one of its most feared.

nodes.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
nodes.why: Animated; Norman Osborn mentors Peter.
nodes.overview: Peter Parker is on his way to becoming a hero, but his path to get there is anything but ordinary.

nodes.title: Captain America: Brave New World
nodes.why: Sam as Captain America, Red Hulk, adamantium — the state of the world right before the New Avengers form.
nodes.overview: After meeting with newly elected U.S. President Thaddeus Ross, Sam finds himself in the middle of an international incident. He must discover the reason behind a nefarious global plot before the true mastermind has the entire world seeing red.

nodes.title: Daredevil: Born Again
nodes.why: New York street level; not connected to the cosmic plot.
nodes.overview: Matt Murdock, a blind lawyer with heightened abilities, is fighting for justice through his bustling law firm, while former mob boss Wilson Fisk pursues his own political endeavors in New York. When their past identities begin to emerge, both men find themselves on an inevitable collision course.

nodes.title: Thunderbolts*
nodes.why: The New Avengers assemble: Yelena, Bucky, Red Guardian, Ghost, John Walker and Bob (Sentry/Void). Its final scene is the Fantastic Four's arrival.
nodes.overview: After finding themselves ensnared in a death trap, seven disillusioned castoffs must embark on a dangerous mission that will force them to confront the darkest corners of their pasts.

nodes.title: Ironheart
nodes.why: Riri Williams after Wakanda Forever; a side story with a Mephisto reveal.
nodes.overview: After the events of Black Panther: Wakanda Forever, technology is pitted against magic when Riri Williams, a young, genius inventor determined to make her mark on the world, returns to her hometown of Chicago. Her unique take on building iron suits is brilliant, but in pursuit of her ambitions, she finds herself wrapped up with the mysterious yet charming Parker Robbins aka "The Hood."

nodes.title: The Fantastic Four: First Steps
nodes.why: Reed, Sue, Johnny, Ben and baby Franklin, from their own universe — and Doom in the tag. The most direct lead-in there is.
nodes.overview: Against the vibrant backdrop of a 1960s-inspired, retro-futuristic world, Marvel's First Family is forced to balance their roles as heroes with the strength of their family bond, while defending Earth from a ravenous space god called Galactus and his enigmatic Herald, Silver Surfer.

nodes.title: Eyes of Wakanda
nodes.why: Animated Wakandan history.
nodes.overview: Follow the adventures of brave Wakandan warriors throughout history in this globe-trotting adventure, where they must carry out dangerous missions to retrieve Vibranium artifacts from the enemies of Wakanda. They are the Hatut Zaraze and this is their story.

nodes.title: Marvel Zombies
nodes.why: Animated, spun out of What If…?
nodes.overview: After the Avengers are overtaken by a zombie plague, a desperate group of survivors discover the key to bringing an end to the super-powered undead, racing across a dystopian landscape and risking life and limb to save their world.

nodes.title: Wonder Man
nodes.why: Street-level Marvel; good television, separate from the cosmic plot.
nodes.overview: Simon and Trevor, two actors at opposite ends of their careers, chase life-changing roles.

nodes.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
nodes.why: The last MCU film before Doomsday (July 2026).
nodes.overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

nodes.title: VisionQuest
nodes.why: Vision's return, following WandaVision and Agatha; airing right before Doomsday.
nodes.overview: With a bounty on his head, Vision must confront his nature and resist Ultron's influence to survive.

nodes.title: Avengers: Doomsday
nodes.why: December 18, 2026. Doctor Doom (Robert Downey Jr.) versus the Avengers, the New Avengers, the Fantastic Four and the X-Men.
nodes.overview: Beloved heroes from three distinct universes are set on a deadly collision course and face an existential threat unlike anything they've ever encountered.

nodes.title: Avengers: Secret Wars
nodes.why: December 2027. The second half of the story.
nodes.overview: An upcoming film in Phase Six of the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU) and the finale of The Multiverse Saga.

note: Tiers are one fan's judgement built on the confirmed cast and the storylines Marvel has announced. The plot itself is not public.
